newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm with crude, high offers.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm with crude, high offers.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were firmer on Tuesday as crude oil futures rallied, traders said.
Skikda material was heard offered by a trader into northwest Europe at $3.75 to $4 over the quoted cif high, but an end user said he would not be prepared to pay much more than +$1.
A Skikda cargo was sold into ARA at cif high +$3.50 on Monday, and a Libyan was also heard bought by a trader on Monday at +$2.50.
Dealers assessed petrochemical naphtha numbers at $1-$2 over the cif high.
